display_long_description:
RTX Lethal Ape is a multiplayer VR horror game where you move with your arms. There is no joystick: run, climb and jump by swinging your hands against the world.

SURVIVE TOGETHER
Explore a dark underground facility with other players. Monsters roam the halls, landmines hide in the rooms, and lockdowns can hit at any time. Stick together, talk over voice chat and keep moving.

MAKE IT YOURS
Earn gold and spend it on hats, shirts and more in the shop, then wear them from the wardrobe. Pick your name and color at the computer.

MODS AND MENUS
Unlock hand menus packed with mods like Fly, Speed Boost, Long Arms, Platforms and more. Change your size, play sounds from the SoundBoard, or show off with name tags and bundles.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Join a public room in seconds, or type a code to play in a private room with friends.

RTX MODE
Turn on RTX mode at the computer for sharper, richer visuals, or switch it off for the classic look. RTX mode is a graphics setting in this game and does not use ray tracing.

Requires an internet connection. Optional in-app purchases are available.
